preview.playersNote: Five Hurricanes and five Panthers who will decide Friday night.

intro.heading: The matchup
intro.body:
The Hurricanes come home hurting. Two straight losses have turned a **4-1** season into **4-2** and a first-place fight into a playoff scramble. The **40-24** second-half collapse against Collins was bad enough. Then Klein scored **22** unanswered after halftime in a **37-14** win that Dave Campbell's named one of its three big takeaways from Thursday night.

**Klein Cain (4-2, 2-2)** hosts **Klein Oak (2-4, 2-2)** on Friday, October 16 at 7 PM at Klein Memorial Stadium. The Panthers just hung **59** on Klein Forest in a 59-3 Friday night rout, and they arrive with momentum. On3's projection has Cain **40-24** with a **76%** win probability. With four games left and Klein and Collins separating at the top of **District 15-6A**, Cain needs this one to stay in the thick of the playoff race. *The bounce-back starts at home.*

players.name: Eyan Johnson
players.copy: Johnson entered Thursday leading Cain at **100.4** rushing yards per game with **nine** total touchdowns. The Bearkats bottled him up; he never found room against a front keyed on him all night. Friday is the reset: when Johnson gets going early, everything else opens up.

players.name: Jace Hanks
players.copy: Hanks owns **eight** touchdown passes and **five** rushing scores, and his 35-yard touchdown run Thursday was Cain's brightest moment. But the Klein loss turned on his two interceptions and the empty red-zone trip. Take care of the ball first; the playmaking takes care of itself.

players.name: Gage Hansberger
players.tag: Cain's Player of the Game vs Klein
players.copy: Hansberger was Cain's Player of the Game against Klein: in on stops all night and the man who blew up the Bearkats' two-point try. The senior captain sets the tone for a front seven staring down a 4-star running back.

players.name: Lovell Christian
players.copy: Christian anchors the interior as a team captain. Oak's ground game runs through **Micah Rhodes** and a quarterback averaging **98.7** rushing yards; the fight starts with Christian's front winning the line of scrimmage.

players.name: Israel Smith
players.copy: Smith's **117**-yard night against Tomball showed what happens when the ball finds him. With defenses keying on Johnson, the perimeter is where Cain's big plays live.

players.name: Micah Rhodes
players.copy: The headliner. Rhodes is a 4-star recruit and 247 Sports' No. 8 running back in the 2028 class who committed to **Texas** on Oct. 8 after decommitting from Oklahoma in April. He ran for **229** yards and a score in Oak's 45-7 win over Tomball Memorial and holds 34 major offers. Cain has to know where **Micah Rhodes (#5)** is on every snap.

players.name: Andre Phillip II
players.copy: Phillip is the dual-threat engine: MaxPreps has the senior at **98.7** rushing yards a game with **six** passing touchdowns and **three** rushing scores. Cain's ends and linebackers have to keep him in the pocket; when he gets loose, Oak's offense hums.

players.name: Antonio Dural
players.copy: Dural leads Oak's ground game at **106.3** rushing yards a game per MaxPreps with **three** total touchdowns. Pair him with Rhodes and the Panthers can attack both edges; fitting the run is job one Friday.

players.name: Carson Varro
players.copy: Varro is the top target outside: **67.7** receiving yards a game and **four** touchdown catches per MaxPreps. If Cain loads the box against the run, Phillip will look his way first.

players.name: Zack Ruysenaars
players.copy: Ruysenaars is the heart of the Oak defense at **9.7** tackles a game with **two** sacks per MaxPreps. Cain's line has to find him before Johnson does.

recruiting.heading: Klein Oak recruiting notes
recruiting.note: A roster-wide check of On3's Klein Oak prospect list, 247Sports coverage, and Rivals coverage as of Oct. 9 found one verified commitment on the current Panthers roster: junior running back **Micah Rhodes** committed to Texas on Oct. 8 after decommitting from Oklahoma in April. No other commitments surfaced; reported offers are not commitments.

items.title: Know where Micah Rhodes is
items.body: The 4-star **Texas** commit ran for **229** yards and a score last week and holds 34 major offers. Fit the run, gang tackle, and make someone else beat you. **Gage Hansberger (#34)** and **Lovell Christian (#45)** set the tone.

items.title: Keep Andre Phillip II in the pocket
items.body: **98.7** rushing yards a game with **six** touchdown passes: the senior quarterback hurts you both ways. Rush lanes, a spy, and no free first downs with his legs.

items.title: Rebuild the run game
items.body: **Eyan Johnson (#16)** never found room against Klein, and the offense stalled with him. Oak's front is the reset button: establish the run early and **Jace Hanks (#9)** gets the play-action looks that produced **eight** touchdown passes.

items.title: Finish drives
items.body: The Klein loss had an empty red-zone trip, a missed **39**-yard field goal, and two interceptions. Friday, touchdowns have to replace field-goal tries.
